transcription.text: Now it is spring. The eggs are tadpoles.
I'm an egg. I'm small and black.
Little Tadpole can't find his mummy.
I'm not your mummy. Your mummy has big eyes.
I'm not your mummy. Your mummy has a big mouth.
Now Little Tadpole has two legs. A duck is coming.
I'm not your mummy. Your mummy has a green body.
Now Little Tadpole has four legs. A tortoise is coming.
I'm not your mummy. Your mummy can jump, but I can't.
Now Little Tadpole has no tail. A frog is coming.
Big eyes, a big mouth, and a green body. And she can jump. Mummy! Mummy!
Oh, my baby. I miss you.
